title: Film Thickness Measurement - Pattern Defects Detection on Candela 8520
subtitle: Post-Lithography Quality Validation for 7nm Node Manufacturing
author: David Okafor

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Candela 8520 system to detect and classify Pattern Defects defects during post-lithography inspection at the 7nm technology node. The test is conducted at Singapore Fab 7 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Pattern Defects defects that are critical to yield at the 7nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Candela 8520 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Candela 8520
- Inspection Type: Film Thickness Measurement
- Target Defect: Pattern Defects
- Process Step: Post-Lithography
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 7nm
- Fab Location: Singapore Fab 7

This test case applies to all Candela 8520 systems deployed at Singapore Fab 7 for post-lithography monitoring in the 7nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Candela 8520
Software Version: v13.6.582
Recipe: FILM_THICKNESS_MEASUREMENT_7nm_POST_LITHOGRAPHY
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Medium (192 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 3mm
Sampling Plan: 21-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Candela 8520 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Film Thickness Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Pattern Defects defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 7nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 92 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 96% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.5% for Film Thickness Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.97 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-12-24
Wafers Tested: 26
Total Defects Found: 1296
Defect Density: 412.53 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 3.1%
Capture Rate: 92.5%
Test Duration: 302 minutes
System Uptime: 98.8%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Candela 8520 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Pattern Defects at the 7nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Minor calibration drift was detected after extended run; re-calibration resolved the issue.

e) SECS/GEM communication was verified with zero packet loss during data transfer.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
